data.body:
Investigation detail moved out of the description (plan-review oversize gate); the description keeps the problem, contract, fix direction, and ACs.

## Instrumented live run (site A)

Unrelated tickets named in every invalidating commit; subject `7931` never changed:

```
[20:55:27] before=aa28b30e   <- CLAIM_ENRICH 9263-b404-cb6c-463f
[20:55:32] after =f3a7dead   <- TICKET_DIGEST 9263  (attempt 1 invalidated)
[20:55:37] after =11d8f1d8   <- DONE_ENRICH  9263  (attempt 2 invalidated)
[20:55:42] after =f076f662   <- CLAIM_ENRICH 932d  (attempt 3 invalidated)
RESULT: remained unstable after 3 attempts
```

## Hermetic proof — single independent variable

Temp git tracker; `collect()` stubbed to return a generation IDENTICAL to `initial_generation`, so "the plan changed" is impossible by construction. Sole variable: whether an UNRELATED ticket commits during the attempt.

| arm | condition | result |
|---|---|---|
| A | unrelated ticket committing every 1s | `PlanReviewGenerationRetryable: plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts` (3x `before != after`) |
| B | tracker quiescent | `{"signed": True}` |
| C | HEAD stable across before/after; one unrelated commit lands only during lock acquisition | 3x `after='under-lock-mismatch'`, then exhausted — isolating the `locked_head != expected_after` clause, since `locked_generation is initial_generation` |

Site C (`store-read-failure`) confirmed separately: with a writer reproducing the locked `add`→`commit` gap, 87/149 (58.4%) unlocked `tracker_head_sha(..., ignore_untracked=True)` probes raised `store-read-failure` while the committed HEAD stayed perfectly readable.

## Churn measurement

Over the last 120 tracker commits the median inter-commit gap is 3s, and 65/120 are rebar's own background enrichment-queue events (`ENQUEUE_ENRICH`/`CLAIM_ENRICH`/`TICKET_DIGEST`/`DONE_ENRICH`), driven from the store write path itself (`_store/event_append.py::_maybe_enrich_drain`) and re-fed by `attest.sign_plan_review`'s post-sign `_enqueue_queue.enqueue` (attest.py:212-215). Measured `collect()` on an affected ticket: 3.3–3.7s (independently 4.3–5.8s under load), so the store-wide fence demands a ~5–7s globally quiescent tracker it structurally never gets. With MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS = 3, no backoff on the head-fence branch, the whole retry budget burns inside one contiguous churn episode. ~25 `sign-review` rounds over ~20 minutes recovered none of the three affected tickets.

## Rivals killed

- "The plan/material drifted" — generation identical by construction in the hermetic arms; also `resign_plan_review`'s staleness guard passed, and 6 back-to-back `collect()` calls under live churn were byte-identical. That path raises `PlanReviewGenerationChanged`, a different exception.
- "Purely environmental contention" — arm B signs; and the churn is rebar's own unconditional background machinery.
- "Regression from 790c" — falsified: 790c's diff (`a4ff2801be`) does not touch `before`/`after`/`locked_head`.

## Why it shipped green

The regression test that encodes the scope invariant — tests/unit/test_plan_review_generation_scope.py ("Signing must survive UNRELATED concurrent tracker writes") — monkeypatches the fence out of existence at line 41: `monkeypatch.setattr(generation, "tracker_head_sha", lambda *a, **k: "b" * 40)`. With the store-wide quantity frozen to a constant, the test can never observe the fence firing, so it proves the d70a identity scoping while the two remaining store-wide comparisons stay untested.

## Defect origin (caused_by reasoning)

`git log -S'if before != after'` and `-S'locked_head != expected_after'` each return exactly one commit: `94e605a29d` (2026-07-22 11:32, rebar-ticket: 5967-4476-7f9f-442d, "Add phased plan-review attestations") — the commit that introduced the fence. Attributed instead to `d70a-d06e-aea0-4008` (`7c3c08df88`, same day, ~9h later, "d70a: scope plan-review signing to subject+related material, not the whole store"): d70a's scope of work was exactly this correction, its commit message diagnoses the class verbatim, fixes the identity comparison — and then states the omission outright: "The within-attempt before/after head fence is unchanged." Deliberate divergence from mechanical blame, recorded here.

Reproduction/experiment scripts were hermetic (temp git trackers, no writes to the shared store); investigation worktree /Users/joeoakhart/debug-signreview-persist, retired.
